title: Revit View Purpose and Template Mapping Fields

entries.name: View purpose
entries.requirement: Each governed view-template mapping shall identify the intended view purpose or use class, such as documentation, coordination, presentation, export, or another approved project purpose.

entries.name: Revit view type
entries.requirement: Each mapping shall identify the applicable Revit view type or bounded type family to which the governed display state applies.

entries.name: Discipline scope
entries.requirement: Where the mapping varies by discipline, the applicable discipline or multi-discipline scope shall be identified explicitly.

entries.name: Approved template identity
entries.requirement: Each mapping shall identify the approved view-template identity or governed template-release reference. Source example template names are not canonical unless separately approved.

entries.name: Detail level basis
entries.requirement: The mapping shall identify the governed detail-level rule where the view purpose requires one, or reference the applicable project/configuration source.

entries.name: Visual style basis
entries.requirement: The mapping shall identify the governed visual-style rule where applicable, or reference the project/configuration source that defines it.

entries.name: Phase and phase-filter basis
entries.requirement: Where phase display is material to the view purpose, the mapping shall identify the applicable phase/phase-filter basis rather than relying on local ad-hoc settings.

entries.name: Linked-model visibility basis
entries.requirement: Where linked-model display is material, the mapping shall identify the governed linked-model visibility rule or reference its governing configuration.

entries.name: Governed filter set
entries.requirement: Recurring parameter-driven display logic shall reference governed filters or filter sets rather than repeated per-view manual overrides.

entries.name: Local override policy
entries.requirement: The mapping shall identify whether local overrides are prohibited, conditionally permitted, or allowed only through an approved exception for the declared view purpose.

entries.name: Approved exception trace
entries.requirement: Any approved departure from the governed view-template/display mapping shall be traceable to its rationale and approval basis.

non_promoted_source_content: The example template names PLN-Coordination, PLN-Documentation, RCP-Documentation, SEC-Documentation and 3D-Coordination are not promoted as enterprise canonical names.
The example view-name syntaxes and suffixes remain source examples until governed by the naming registry.
Recommended detail levels, visual styles and phase-filter examples are not promoted as universal values where the source leaves project or discipline applicability unresolved.

provenance.migration_note: Migrated the machine-readable mapping fields required to make view-template governance executable without canonicalizing source example names or unresolved project values.
